android-r596125.notes: Official Google AOSP clang-r596125 from android.googlesource.com (branch main-kernel), fetched with a sparse git checkout of that one directory.

llvm-23.1.6.notes: Upstream LLVM 23.1.6 release. Make jobs are capped to stay inside runner memory.

llvm-slim-23.1.6.notes: Slim LLVM 23.1.6 from kernel.org (smaller download, built for kernel use). Make jobs are capped like the upstream LLVM entry.

alchemist-llvm-23.notes: Alchemist LLVM 23 (clang 23.0.1), release lto-20261105 from nekoshirro/Alchemist-LLVM. Pinned by SHA-256. Make jobs are capped like the other LLVM entries.
